criteria.name: Backend Engineering Experience
criteria.ten_point_description: Demonstrates 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a focus on relevant technologies and systems.

criteria.name: Proficiency in Programming Languages
criteria.ten_point_description: Exhibits strong proficiency in Python or Go, with practical examples of projects or systems developed.

criteria.name: High-Throughput System Experience
criteria.ten_point_description: Has hands-on experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems, specifically handling over 10k requests per second.

criteria.name: Financial Systems Familiarity
criteria.ten_point_description: Demonstrates familiarity with financial systems, trading platforms, or payment processing, showcasing relevant projects or roles.

criteria.name: Database Proficiency
criteria.ten_point_description: Shows proficiency with PostgreSQL and at least one NoSQL database, with examples of database design and optimization.

criteria.name: Containerization and Distributed Teams
criteria.ten_point_description: Exhibits experience with containerization technologies (Docker/Kubernetes) and the ability to work effectively in distributed, async-first teams.
